text:
cassie: Heads up — staging run found a memory leak in the quantized KV cache with kernel v3.7.4-quant. Repro on heavy prefix workloads, mem keeps growing across 10+ iterations.

deploy-bot: Attempted canary deploy of v3.7.4 -> failed smoke: OOM in runtime-worker[pid]. Canary auto-stopped.

jordan: Noted. Please pause any night rollouts. Suggest we pin canary to v3.7.3 and prepare a hotfix build for 3.7.4.

pat: I peeked at the diff — missing free in `kv_cache::evict()` on the quant path. Patch looks straightforward. I can build a hotfix and push to staging in ~45m.

maria: QA can run regression harness once you push. Need the exact build tag to kick off `kv_heavy` suite.

ryan: Quick risk assessment — if we pin, define rollback criteria: OOM rate >3% OR sustained p95 latency delta >250ms for >5m, automatic rollback. Also we should bump autoscaler thresholds during canary to avoid noisy scale-ups.

jordan: I'll put a deploy hold and apply the pin. Command I'll run: `deployctl pin --service runtime-engine --kernel v3.7.3 --regions us-west-2`

cassie: Also update the release notes / changelog with: "Fix: kv cache leak in quantized int8 path — prevents memory growth under long-context workloads."

maria: QA starting smoke now: `tests/kv_heavy.sh --quant --repeat=50` (will stream logs).

deploy-bot: Pin applied to canary (us-west-2). v3.7.4 rollouts halted. Rollout control set to manual.

pat: Pushing hotfix build `runtime-engine:v3.7.4-hotfix1` to staging now. Will include the fix and an extra allocator guard.

ryan: Added rollback conditions and monitoring thresholds to the incident doc: https://confluence.internal/redwood/kv-quant-leak (please add any additional checks).

maria: Smoke results so far: 50/50 runs passed, memory profile stable on staging for 30m. Continuing soak for 30m more.

cassie: Plan ack: 1) keep v3.7.3 pinned in canary 2) soak hotfix in staging 3) if green, schedule controlled rollout tonight with 30m holdbacks per region. Any objections?

jordan: +1 from me. Pat/Maria please update the release note blurb and add the deploy checklist.

oncall-bot: Paging @eng-oncall: memory-leak kv-cache (quant) — canary pinned, see thread.

maria: Final check after 60m soak — alloc heatmap shows no drift. Recommend proceeding to staged rollout after 2h total soak.

cassie: Thanks all. I'll draft the release note + create the deploy ticket and checklist. (reaction :thumbsup:)
